news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: CZ denies Binance sold crypto, Bitwise sees Solana at $1,100 by 2031, and more
news.summary: In today's newsletter, CZ denies Binance sold crypto as bitcoin rebounds from four-month low; Bitwise sees Solana reaching $1,100 by 2031 in bull case; and more.

news.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
news.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

news.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
news.summary: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.

news.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
news.summary: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

news.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
news.summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

news.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
news.summary: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

news.title: CFTC backs blockchain-based derivatives infrastructure as Backpack, tZERO win approvals
news.summary: The CFTC has approved the first set of applications to establish regulated derivatives and exchange clearing operations that use blockchain.

news.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
news.summary: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

news.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
news.summary: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

news.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
news.summary: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

news.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
news.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

news.title: Trezor hit by another shipping partner data leak, affecting 27,000 Skladon orders
news.summary: Trezor warns of scam calls and physical security risks after customer addresses leak at shipping partner.

news.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
news.summary: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

news.title: Democratic senators warn SEC’s tokenized stock exemption has illicit finance gaps
news.summary: Four Democratic senators are raising concerns about the Securities and Exchange Commission's newly unveiled innovation exemption.

news.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
news.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

news.title: Peraire-Bueno brothers acquitted of wire fraud in $25 million Ethereum MEV case
news.summary: A judge acquitted the Peraire-Bueno brothers of wire fraud over the Ethereum MEV exploit, ruling prosecutors showed no misrepresentation.

news.title: Bitwise sees Solana reaching $1,100 by 2031 in bull case as onchain trading grows
news.summary: Bitwise predicts the SOL token will be valued at $1,100 by 2031, versus $385 in the base case and $80 in the bear case.

news.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
news.summary: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

news.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
news.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

news.title: Solflare CEO says AI security reviews are essential, touts ‘bunker mode’ and MoneyGram deal
news.summary: Vidor Gencel says AI catches chained exploits humans miss, and details the wallet's "bunker mode," privacy mode, and MoneyGram USDC cash-out.

news.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

news.title: Winklevoss-backed Cypherpunk buys Zcash dip as mining debut delivers $2.6 million operating profit
news.summary: Since quarter-end, Cypherpunk bought another 3,775 ZEC for about $3.5 million at an average price of $920.40.

news.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
news.summary: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

news.title: Standard Chartered says Japan’s bond tokenization plans could help drive RWA market to $2 trillion
news.summary: Standard Chartered said Japan's bond tokenization plans could help the tokenized RWA market reach its $2 trillion forecast by 2028.

news.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
news.summary: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

news.title: Privacy on Solana is ‘non-negotiable’ for institutional adoption, Mert Mumtaz says
news.summary: Mert Mumtaz sees privacy becoming standard on blockchains, much like HTTPS did for the modern internet.

news.title: Supreme Court rejects Custodia Bank’s bid for Fed master account
news.summary: The Supreme Court has said it would not take up a Custodia Bank's challenge to secure a Federal Reserve master account.

news.title: Boris Johnson backs tokenization months after likening bitcoin to a ‘Ponzi scheme’
news.summary: Boris Johnson backed blockchain and tokenization at Solana Breakpoint but reiterated his concerns about crypto speculation.

news.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
news.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

news.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
news.summary: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

news.title: DeFi Development Corp. adds 9,482 SOL as CHAD dividend streak hits 31 days
news.summary: DeFi Development added 9,482 SOL last week, lifting its Solana treasury to about 2.62 million tokens in its 10th straight week of growth.

news.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
news.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

news.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
news.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

news.title: Tom Lee says Ethereum’s ‘waterfall decline in price’ defies fundamentals as Bitmine adds 7,653 ETH
news.summary: Bitmine acquired 7,653 ETH as Tom Lee questioned the rate of ether's recent decline against improving institutional developments.

news.title: Layer 2 Scaling Explained
news.summary: Layer 2 101 explains why blockchains need to scale and how Layer 2s help. It covers rollups, sidechains and appchains, monolithic vs modular design, Layer 2 tokens and incentives, and the trade-offs between speed, cost and security.

news.title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
news.summary: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

news.title: Bitwise CIO says bitcoin may fall further in the near term but still calls it the best risk-adjusted trade of the next decade
news.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan said bitcoin could fall further in the near term but stood by his bullish long-term outlook.

news.title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
news.summary: Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.

news.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
news.summary: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

news.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
news.summary: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.

news.title: ‘This dip could use a little orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 485 BTC for $33 million as bitcoin tumbles
news.summary: Strategy's latest acquisitions came during a week that saw bitcoin drop to its lowest level in four months.

news.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
news.summary: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

news.title: Binance Pay Later offers credit backed by Bitcoin, Ether and BNB holdings
news.summary: Eligible users can access up to 1,000 USDC in credit against their Bitcoin, Ether or BNB for purchases via Binance Card or QR Pay.

news.title: Old crypto feud reignites: Why OKX's Star Xu blames Binance for two years of October crashes
news.summary: CZ says Binance isn’t selling crypto and he has been buying. OKX founder Star Xu accuses him of misleading customers about the exchange’s role in successive October crashes.

news.title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
news.summary: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.

news.title: Solana drops ‘mainnet beta’ label and adopts protocol version 1.0
news.summary: The Solana Foundation retired the network’s “mainnet beta” label and introduced Solana 1.0 as a shared protocol version.

news.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
news.summary: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

news.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk
news.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs let each ledger verify the other leg was locked, so neither currency settled unless both did, with no shared ledger or intermediary.

news.title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

news.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border FX settlement with CBDCs
news.summary: Project Simbolon aims to reduce the cost and time of cross-border settlement and promote common standards for payments and FX

news.title: Upbit parent Dunamu posts $14 million Q3 net loss as revenue falls 61%
news.summary: Upbit operator Dunamu posted a net loss of $13.8 million in Q3, swinging from $177 million in profit the same quarter last year.

news.title: BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
news.summary: Bitcoin traders awaited Nvidia Q3 earnings after BTC price selling pressure saw a dip below $62,000 at the weekend.

news.title: Vitalik Buterin backs higher gas costs for creating accounts and deploying smart contracts to help Ethereum scale
news.summary: Buterin defended Ethereum's proposed gas repricing, citing the need to increase transaction capacity without compromising decentralization.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $65,000 as Nasdaq closes with 2.5% loss
news.summary: Strategy and Strive might be the only buyers left in BTC, and each — constrained by weak stock prices — made only modest purchases last week.

news.title: FOMC minutes, Nvidia earnings, Russia’s retail crypto rules: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 16.

news.title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
news.summary: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

news.title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
news.summary: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

news.title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
news.summary: Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.

news.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
news.summary: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

news.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
news.summary: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

news.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper
news.summary: Toto Finance’s 22 million ADA treasury request expired Sunday with about 20 million ADA in favor, and none of Cardano’s seven constitutional committee members voted yes.

news.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
news.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.

news.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
news.summary: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

news.title: Bitcoin’s biggest bet is now a drop below $60,000, not a rally above $100,000
news.summary: The $60,000 put has replaced the $100,000 call as bitcoin’s biggest options bet on Deribit, with $900 million in open interest after the recent slide.

news.title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
news.summary: The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.

news.title: Did prediction markets call the U.S. midterm election?: State of Crypto
news.summary: Prediction markets and polls largely aligned by the end of the 2026 election cycle, and both had notable misses.

news.title: Crypto insiders aren't counting on silver linings in Congress' 'lame duck' session
news.summary: With ascendent Democrats ready to pursue their own crypto and tech agendas next year, the final weeks of this session probably won't produce crypto surprises.

news.title: Changing of Lagarde: How the candidates to be next ECB president view bitcoin, stablecoins and CBDCs
news.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down from her post in February 2027, and none of the primary candidates to succeed her are great fans of crypto.

news.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
news.summary: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.
